summary: iOS (Capacitor) load fix check. PASSED: 1) www.trademainhub.com returns 308 to trademainhub.com/, which returns 200. At 390x844 the Hub Trade landing renders (logo, Log in, Start free) and /login shows the login form. 2) https://trademainhub.com/api/auth/me returns 401 JSON {detail:'Not authenticated'}. 3) Logging in on prod as tester@hubtrade.app returns 200 and lands on /app, showing the 'Tester Construction LLC' owner dashboard. 4) Config: both capacitor.config.json files have server.url https://trademainhub.com. Info.plist WKAppBoundDomains contains trademainhub.com, www.trademainhub.com, checkout.stripe.com and js.stripe.com. ios/App/App/public/index.html is identical to www/index.html. 5) The placeholder redirects at once: served from a stub origin, it landed on https://trademainhub.com/. FAILED: the placeholder's 6s fallback. After 6s the spinner hides and the message changes, but the 'Try again' button stays hidden (computed display:none).

ui_bugs.issue: The 'Try again' button never appears. The setTimeout and go() set retry.style.display = "", which removes the inline style, so the stylesheet rule '#retry { display: none; }' applies again. Users see a message telling them to try again but there is no button.
Tapping 'Try again' does not restart the 6s timer. If the retry also hangs, the spinner shows 'Connecting…' forever with no way to retry, which repeats the original stuck-screen symptom.

action_items: In /app/ios-app/www/index.html: in the setTimeout, use retry.style.display = 'inline-block' (not ''); in go(), use spin.style.display = 'block'. Better: toggle a CSS class.
Move the 6s setTimeout inside go() and clear any previous timer, so each retry gets its own fallback.
Run `npx cap sync ios` (or copy again) so ios/App/App/public/index.html picks up the fix.

The placeholder test file /app/frontend/public/ios-placeholder-test.html does not exist. The preview URL serves the React SPA fallback and redirects to /. Add it only if you want an in-browser test page.
Optional: set server.errorPath in capacitor.config.json (Capacitor 5+) so a failed remote load shows a local fallback page.
critical_code_review_comments: Placeholder display toggling uses '' and so falls back to the CSS rule. The retry button can never become visible.
The timer is armed only once at load and not again when the user retries.

The placeholder only appears while server.url is still loading or if the remote load fails. WKWebView keeps the current page when a provisional navigation fails, so the 6s fallback is the only error UI the user gets. It must work.

success_rate.frontend: 80% (4 of 5 checks passed; placeholder retry button failed)

test_credentials: tester@hubtrade.app / TestHub2026! works on production. The owner account was not used.
seed_data_creation: None. No data was created on production (login only).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Desktop Chromium replaces the page with chrome-error when location.replace is aborted. To test the placeholder timer, serve the HTML via page.context.route on a fake origin and replace 'window.location.replace(APP_URL)' with a stub, then check the computed display of #spin and #retry after 6.5s. Expect #retry to be visible after the fix.
rca of the issue: Repro: load www/index.html with the navigation hanging or stubbed and wait 6s. #msg changes to the connection message and #spin hides, but #retry stays display:none (getComputedStyle). Cause: element.style.display='' only removes the inline style, so the stylesheet's #retry{display:none} wins. Fix: set an explicit display value or toggle a class.
